comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 W4A16 latent-MoE routed-expert kernel (w4a16_mxfp4_latent_routed_moe). 'backends' lists the backend strings; the op entry carries the fixed geometry backend='auto' matches a call against (the compiled-in guards stay authoritative). FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 disables the fused kernel regardless of this file: backend='auto' routes to the composable 'reference' path, explicit backend='specialized' raises.

w4a16_mxfp4_latent_routed_moe.weights: mxfp4 e2m1 packed uint8 (low nibble = even K) + ue8m0 group-32 scales
